question.html:
A uniform rigid beam of mass 15.0 kg and length 3.00 m is hinged to a vertical wall. It is held in a horizontal position by a light cable attached to the right end of the beam and to a point on the wall directly above the hinge. The cable makes an angle of 35.0° with the horizontal beam.

a

Outline why the hinge must exert a vertical upward force on the beam for it to remain in equilibrium.

[1]

b

Calculate the tension in the cable.

[2]

c

A mass of 8.0 kg is suspended from the right end of the beam. The cable has a maximum breaking strength of 250 N. Determine whether the cable will snap.

[2]
